title: Never Trust the Client
summary: Security rule #1: anything a client sends or holds — arguments, memory, even 'which remote fired' — can be fabricated by exploiters. The server must independently validate every claim before acting.

verification.notes: Roblox security guidance: client code and memory are modifiable by exploiters.

explanation.whatItIs: The mindset: every client is potentially an adversary. Not because players are evil — because tools exist that let anyone rewrite client behavior, and your server can't tell them apart.
explanation.whyItExists: Roblox clients run on player hardware where memory and code are inspectable/editable. Anything client-side is public AND mutable.
whenToUse: Validate every remote argument: type, range, ownership, cooldown, game state
Re-derive outcomes server-side (raycast re-checks, distance checks)
Keep authoritative values server-only: currency, permissions, inventories
Rate-limit per player to stop spam-based exploits
whenNotToUse: As an excuse to move EVERYTHING server-side at the cost of responsiveness — validate, don't paralyze
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Client says: "I dealt 999999 damage"
Server asks:  could they, really?
             - weapon equipped?        (state check)
             - target in range?        (distance check)
             - cooldown elapsed?       (time check)
             - damage value plausible? (data check)
Only then apply it.
```
tips: The player parameter Roblox injects is trustworthy; everything AFTER it is not
Server-only containers keep logic away from prying eyes (obfuscation, not protection — determined attackers still probe remotes)
Log suspicious activity to spot exploit patterns
Design exploits out: if the server always decides, client hacks change nothing
commonMistakes: Hiding 'secret' data in ReplicatedStorage — visible to all clients
Validating once at UI level only — remotes bypass UI
Assuming 'nobody will bother' — popular games get targeted automatically

examples.title: Validated purchase
examples.code:
-- ❌ TRUSTING:
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, amount)
    player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += amount   -- free money!
end)

-- ✅ VALIDATING:
local PRICES = { Potion = 50 }
local cooldowns = {}

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
    if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then return end          -- type
    local price = PRICES[itemName]
    if not price then return end                              -- known item
    local now = os.clock()
    if cooldowns[player] and now - cooldowns[player] < 1 then return end  -- rate
    cooldowns[player] = now

    local coins = player.leaderstats and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    if coins and coins.Value >= price then                    -- affordability
        coins.Value -= price
        grantItem(player, itemName)                           -- server grants
    end
end)
